scope: USSR / Russia cast batch 1: the one registered person of the certified USSR -> Russia case with accepted C01 holder observations and no art for the requested window (Mikhail Gorbachev, 1991; C01-49 President of the USSR and C01-41 CPSU General Secretary), plus one conditional reserve (Nikolai Ryzhkov, 1990) who is not prepared because his only research (C01-26) is not yet accepted. Gorbachev has one dated, freely licensed likeness photograph copied byte-identical into the repository and one exact prompt. The other 22 people with accepted observations have no registry person ID and are listed for a batch 2. No image has been generated, edited or labelled; Codex renders and Claude reviews afterwards.
prepared_by: Claude: one preparation agent and one independent verification agent for Gorbachev, assembled and mechanically corrected by Claude on 2026-10-02. This is not human review, not Codex review and not user approval.

also_checked.note: Holds no Gorbachev or Ryzhkov holder observation.

rules: All holder dictionaries below are copied exactly from accepted C01 research (ussr.json). Grouping them under an existing person ID does not promote dates, prove a tenure or extend an office.
Point observations are never expanded to full terms. No start or end is inferred from a successor, resignation announcement, dissolution, suspension or later signature; those remain claims.

Requested windows are appearance intervals from the CLAUDE-C06-RUSSIA-01 claim with exclusive ends. Where a bound comes from party_leaders.json, leaders_1990.json or the gap ledger rather than accepted research, the person entry says so.
Pending observations (c01_integrated_pending) are cited only for context and are never used as accepted evidence.
Real history stops at 2026-09-07; every window in this batch lies before it.

Image dates describe the source photograph, never the appearance window, at the precision the source supports. Every age gap and every artistic extension (standing body, hands, trousers, shoes, colours added to a black-and-white photograph) is declared in the prompt and here.

Likeness references are dated photographs of the exact person whose licence string, as stated by Commons extmetadata, matches FREE_LICENSES exactly. Original bytes and metadata stay outside Git; the repository copy is byte-identical. Nothing was cropped, edited, converted or labelled.

Claude generates, edits and labels no image. Codex renders with its built-in image tool from the exact prompt file and input order in render-request-batch-01.md and returns the unchanged outputs; Claude then performs and records the identity, likeness, era and visual review. No review flag is true yet.
Each review batch contains at most ten people. A person without a registry person ID is not prepared, because its art could not be registered and this task may not edit party_leaders.json.
HTTP response headers are never saved, copied, cited, hashed or committed.

Prompt sha256 values are over the LF bytes committed to Git (equal to `git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum`). No .gitattributes rule covers the prompt yet, so a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true writes CRLF bytes; that hash is recorded beside the pin.
Gorbachev's birth date is the registry value (party_leaders.json), not accepted C01 research.

requested_window.basis: Accepted C01-49 President of the USSR holder observations attested 1991-01-22, 1991-08-22 and 1991-10-05, and the accepted C01-41 CPSU General Secretary holder observation attested 1991-08-22 (all with from and until null). The start continues his existing 1990 art (mikhail-gorbachev-cartoon-1990-v1.png, 1990-01-01 to 1991-01-01). The exclusive end is the day after 25 December 1991, the gap ledger's audit boundary for USSR-identity roles ('not an accepted dissolution date'); it is not an accepted term end. He is the USSR card's leader by office_links (since 1985-03-11, registry). The window is an appearance interval, not a tenure, and the claim record marks it as needing Codex agreement.

holder.name: Михаил Сергеевич Горбачев
holder.note: Attested on 22 January 1991: his decree on the withdrawal of the 50- and 100-rouble notes, printed in Pravda No. 20 of 23 January 1991, is signed 'Президент Союза Советских Социалистических Республик М. ГОРБАЧЕВ' and dated 'Москва, Кремль. 22 января 1991 г.'.
holder.uncertainty: A signed decree as printed in the party newspaper (a facsimile hosted by a private Internet Archive upload): an attestation on the decree's date only.

holder.name: Михаил Сергеевич Горбачев
holder.note: Attested on 22 August 1991: decree УП-2443 in the official gazette (Vedomosti 1991 No. 35, art. 1008) is signed 'Президент Союза Советских Социалистических Республик М. ГОРБАЧЕВ' and dated 'Москва, Кремль. 22 августа 1991 г.'.
holder.uncertainty: The Vice-President's decree of 18 August 1991 on assuming the President's duties, the statement of the 'Soviet leadership' and the acting styling are claims only; the Presidium's resolution of 21 August declaring the removal unlawful is a claim. No break, resumption day, start or end is recorded.

holder.name: Михаил Сергеевич Горбачев
holder.note: Attested on 5 October 1991: decree УП-2668 in the official gazette (Vedomosti 1991 No. 41, art. 1164) is signed 'Президент Союза Советских Социалистических Республик М. ГОРБАЧЕВ' and dated 'Москва, Кремль. 5 октября 1991 г.', the latest Soviet-side signature reviewed.
holder.uncertainty: Not an end. The 25 December 1991 statement has no Soviet primary text in this packet (SU-PRES-04); the CLAUDE-C01-05 observation of that day rests on US records and sets no until.

holder.name: Михаил Сергеевич Горбачев
holder.note: Attested on 22 August 1991: the Central Committee Secretariat's statement, printed undated in that day's Pravda, calls for a plenum 'с непременным участием Генерального секретаря ЦК КПСС М. С. Горбачева'.
holder.uncertainty: The latest reviewed record styling him in office. His own words of 26 August 1991 that he has laid down the duties state no day, and the statement of 24 August 1991 is known only from leads, so until is null; no end is inferred from them or from the party's suspension.

holder.name: Mikhail Gorbachev
holder.note: Office observation: the US memorandum of the call of 25 December 1991 names him President of the Soviet Union. His announced cessation that day is recorded in separate role claims (su_telcon_resignation_decrees_19911225, su_bush_address_resign_19911225).
holder.uncertainty: SURU-TR91-06: no Soviet instrument or effective moment has been accepted, so no until is set; the 25 December announcement is a dated claim, not a term boundary. The 1990 election and oath remain unsourced.

prompt.sha256_basis: LF bytes as committed (git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum)
prompt.superseded_draft_note: The preparer's draft (never committed) dated the photograph 24 October 1991 and put the birthmark 'mostly toward his left side'; both were corrected after independent verification (see verification).

identity_review.finding: Preserve the existing person ID and the existing 1990 portrait, reference and prompt (all unchanged). This window adds a second appearance from a photograph dated October 1991, inside the window.

The 1990 cartoon's identity_source is observed_portrait NARA 186420 (Susan Biddle, 9 September 1990, PDM-1.0), which shows spectacles; the 1991 reference shows none, so this prompt asks for no glasses. Continuity is an open item for Codex.

Birthmark placement checked by the assembler on a downscaled copy of the reference: the main arc starts on his right side of the crown (viewer's left in the photograph) and curves to about the middle of the upper forehead; the small separate spots lie above his right eye. The prompt states this side explicitly and forbids mirroring.

problems_and_dispositions.problem: The photograph's date provenance was misstated as 1991-10-24 'stated by the uploader'. The Commons revision history shows the uploader Dmedvedev83's original upload (rev 794636807, 2023-08-20) gave |date=1991-10 and 'Moscow, October 1991' / 'Москва, октябрь 1991 года'; the day 24 was added on 2025-07-09 by a third-party editor, MasterRus21thCentury (rev 1054800689, summary 'corr'), with no cited source.
problems_and_dispositions.disposition: Fixed in this record and the prompt: the assembler fetched and pinned the revision history (api-revisions-gorbachevms.json), confirmed the verifier's account, and recorded photograph_date '1991-10' with month precision attributed to the upload revision, with a note on the later unsourced edit. The prompt, credit, age_gap_note and date_precision now say October 1991; the scratch original was renamed from '...-19911024-...' to '...-199110-...' (bytes unchanged). The prompt hashes were recomputed. The reference filename year 1991 is unaffected.

problems_and_dispositions.problem: The prompt put the birthmark 'mostly toward his left side'. In Image 2 the head is turned toward the viewer's right, so the visible ear is his right ear; the stain's arc starts on the crown on his right side and curves down to about the forehead midline, and the small separate spots sit above his right eye. The wrong side could lead the renderer to mirror his most recognisable feature.
problems_and_dispositions.disposition: Fixed in the prompt: the birthmark clause now describes an arc that starts on his right side of the crown (the viewer's left in Image 2) and curves down to about the middle of the upper forehead, with small separate spots on his right side above his right eye, 'placed exactly as in Image 2 and never mirrored'. The assembler confirmed the side on a downscaled view copy. Prompt hashes recomputed.

holder.name: Николай Иванович Рыжков
holder.note: Named as the Congress stenographic report of 26 December 1990 prints him in full ('Николая Ивановича Рыжкова', genitive); the gazette prints 'Н. Рыжков'. Attested on 12 January 1990: the joint resolution of the USSR and RSFSR Councils of Ministers No. 37, printed in the RSFSR government gazette (1990 No. 8, art. 60), is signed 'Председатель Совета Министров СССР Н. Рыжков'.

holder.name: Николай Иванович Рыжков
holder.note: Attested on 24 November 1990: Council of Ministers resolution No. 1177 on the legal portal is signed 'Председатель Совета Министров СССР Н.РЫЖКОВ', the latest signature of his reviewed. A separate observation from 12 January 1990; the signature of 26 May 1990 (resolution 525) is a role claim.
holder.uncertainty: No reviewed source states the day his chairmanship ended: the reports of his heart attack and illness (26-27 December 1990), Law 1862-I, the Premier's approval of 14 January 1991 (its only recorded publication withdrawn; SU-GOV-05) and the pension resolution 1907-I (a lead) are not used as an end, so no until is set.

The copyright holder's approval was received by e-mail and reviewed by a VRT member (ticket #2022050610007575). likeness_references.rights_statement: Retained source statement: CC BY-SA 4.0 with VRT permission ticket #2022050610007575 (category 'Items with VRTS permission confirmed'). The upload revision carried {{cc-by-sa-4.0}}{{PermissionTicket|id=2022050610007575}}; on 2023-10-21 (rev 813789119) the licence section was replaced by the {{Leo Medvedev}} template, and the current extmetadata still states CC BY-SA 4.0. The uploader is not the photographer; the licence rests on the VRT-reviewed grant, and whether Medvedev took the photograph for a press employer is not established (open item). Attribution and share-alike apply. The copied bytes are the original upload, unretouched.
likeness_references.people_in_frame: Gorbachev alone: black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait, head in three-quarter view toward the viewer's right, plain dark grey backdrop; dark pinstripe suit, white pointed-collar shirt, dark tie with thin light diagonal stripes; no glasses, no other people, no text or symbols.
likeness_references.age_gap_note: Registry birth date 1931-03-02. The photograph (October 1991, month precision) shows him at 60. It lies inside the requested window, about 9 to 10 months after its start (1991-01-01, age 59) and about 2 to 3 months before its exclusive end (1991-12-26, age 60), so no age adjustment is asked for; the prompt asks for a man of 59 to 60. Declared artistic extensions: the full standing body, hands, trousers and shoes (from a head-and-shoulders photograph) and all colours (the photograph is black and white).
likeness_references.colour_note: The reference is an 8-bit greyscale JPEG (PIL mode L). Every colour in the card (skin, the reddish-plum birthmark, the charcoal pinstripe suit, the burgundy tie) is an artistic choice, and the prompt says so. NARA 186435 (colour, 31 July 1991) shows a dark suit, a white shirt and a dark red patterned tie: corroboration only, not a render input.
likeness_references.limitation: Month-precision date from the archive uploader; licence via a VRT-reviewed grant from the photographer's archive rather than the photographer's own upload; greyscale; head and shoulders only.
rejected_candidates: File:President Bush and President Gorbachev sign the Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (START) in the Kremlin in Moscow... - NARA - 186435.tif (Susan Biddle, White House / NARA, 31 July 1991, 'Public domain', 3000x2043, 18,387,306 bytes, Commons SHA-1 b4230aaefd9845612dcf60cb1f90781c5f330a38): the licence and date qualify. Viewed through a Commons 1280px thumbnail: Gorbachev is seated at the signing table looking down through reading glasses, his face is small, three other men are in frame and US and Soviet flags are prominent, so it is a weak likeness. Kept as colour corroboration only (not-selected/nara-186435-thumb-1280.jpg, sha256 fcac292f0860be75a1203b6154e543b79fc7a18e4509f5cd7aac577a460ab2fe); original TIF not downloaded.

File:Горбачев (3).jpg and File:Горбачев (4).jpg (uploader Kv.petrova, 'Own work', CC BY-SA 4.0, year-only date 1991, 1653x2339 / 480x725): the subject is shown meeting the poet's daughter Sara al-Ayadhi (two people); the own-work claim on an apparent 1991 print is unverified and the date is year-only; rejected from metadata.

Kremlin.ru (CC BY 4.0) has no 1991 photographs of Gorbachev on Commons (its files start in 2000). No RIA Novosti (CC BY-SA 3.0) file of Gorbachev dated 1991 turned up in the Commons searches; the 1991 RIAN files found show Raisa Gorbacheva and Boris Yeltsin.
